title: Step 30 noncollapsed bubble / variational-field route audit
scope: Explore-level algebraic and scaling checks; not a proof or refutation of Yau 26.

eh_volume_gauge_expansion.interpretation: The r^{-4} relative trace vanishes: Eguchi-Hanson is in volume gauge and ordinary ADM/mass/volume flux is blind at leading order. The anisotropic coefficient H^4 is nonzero and is detected only after pairing with the orbifold H_2 curvature term in the Biquard-Ozuch/Ozuch Pohozaev obstruction.

eguchi_hanson_first_obstruction_algebra.statement: For an Eguchi-Hanson bubble with orientation v in Lambda^2_+, first obstruction = R_+ v; an orientation can kill it iff det(R_+)=0.
eguchi_hanson_first_obstruction_algebra.source_formula: Ozuch 2021 Theorem 4.6 and Corollary 4.10: for EH H^4=-theta_1^- o omega_1^+/(2 r^4), the radial and rotation Pohozaev obstructions are equivalent to R_e^{+,(1)}(H_2) omega_1^+ = 0.

annular_detection_scaling.model: If EH bubble coefficient is t^4 and cone-field non-Killing error contributes ~ eta^2 r^4, detection requires eta^2 r^4 << t^4, i.e. eta << t^2/r^2.
annular_detection_scaling.interpretation: At natural intermediate annuli r=t^alpha, alpha<1, the needed cone closeness is much stronger than naive GH/C1 neck closeness. This supports replacing transplanted cone rotation fields by variational minimizers with prescribed asymptotics/boundary data, whose error is controlled by an energy minimum rather than by raw annular C1 closeness.

variational_almost_killing_operator.functional: J(Z)=int_Omega |L_Z g|^2 dmu = 4 int |delta^* Z|^2 dmu
variational_almost_killing_operator.euler_lagrange_interior: delta_g delta_g^* Z = 0 for fixed boundary/asymptotic data (sign conventions may change); on a closed manifold the kernel consists Killing fields.
variational_almost_killing_operator.komar_pohozaev_pairing: For divergence-free symmetric T, int_boundary T(Z,n)=1/2 int_Omega <T,L_Z g>; if Z is Killing, the bulk term vanishes. For approximate/variational Z, the error is the minimized L_Z energy paired with the tensor being tested, not a derivative of Ricci.
variational_almost_killing_operator.relevance_to_Yau26: This object can be used in two distinct places: (i) collapse, where central almost-Killing fields should be obtained by minimizing on covers/scale windows; (ii) noncollapsed bubbles, where rotation/conformal asymptotics can be imposed and the resulting minimizer may define the Pohozaev projection without needing full Biquard-Ozuch normal form for the original C0-pinched metric.

route_decision: For noncollapsed P4+, if the Cheeger-Naber singular set is empty, the limit is a smooth weak Einstein metric and M is eventually diffeomorphic to it; this half is conceptually closed modulo standard convergence/diffeomorphism details.

If singularities occur, finite CGB energy bounds the number of bubbles. The decisive bridge is a Pohozaev/Komar projection that works for C0 Ricci-pinched metrics and forces the Ozuch/Biquard first obstruction R_+ v to vanish.
The EH ordinary mass/volume flux is zero at leading order; the useful flux is the Taub/Pohozaev obstruction paired with the orbifold H2 curvature term and cone rotations/conformal radial field.
Cone-field transplantation requires unrealistically strong annular closeness; variational minimizers with prescribed asymptotics are a more faithful next execution target.
